flags: The cache supports only an approach to 10,000 feet at Indian Summit, not an exact summit elevation. No drive time, specific grades, switchbacks or seasonal closure is documented.

Castle Gate death totals are reconciled as 171 workers plus one rescuer using 11. Nationality breakdowns in 03 and 11 disagree and are omitted. The robbery in current is supported but replaced by the coal-town story, not rejected as false.
Duchesne’s expedition account is supported as a historical attributed observation, but omitted in favor of the road-linked bridge history. No present survival of the 1908 bridge is implied.

The Duchesne page calls the route a National Scenic Byway; the cached Utah code distinguishes the Indian Canyon State Scenic Byway from the larger Dinosaur Diamond National Scenic Byway. Followed the code.
No current motifs were supplied. Existing titles and coordinate values are preserved, including their original precision.
